embeds.title: ⚔️ BREAKING NEWS: THE KING HAS ENTERED THE ARENA
embeds.description:
*From the chronicles of the Ashen Kingdom — an in-world story.*

The arena gates trembled before dawn. From the smoke came the clatter of a thousand bones. The skeleton army had gathered to claim the throne.

Then a single figure stepped into the fire.

A crown. A sword. A royal temper the undead were about to regret.

With a thunderous charge, the King tore through the first ranks. Blades flashed, shields shattered, and the burning colosseum roared as if the stones themselves remembered their ruler.

Witnesses report acrobatic leaps, spinning strikes, and bursts of royal fury. The skeletons have declined to comment — mostly because they no longer have jaws.

👑 **The gates are open.** Are you ready to survive the next wave?
